description: List the event types you can subscribe a webhook endpoint to. Returns event-type strings like `domain.registered`, `domain.renewed`, `domain.transfer.completed`, `domain.expiring`, and `dns.record.created|updated|deleted`. Use these values (or `*` for all, or a prefix wildcard like `dns.*`) when calling create_webhook.
name: get_webhook_event_types
title: Get Webhook Event Types
